svg.aria-label: Code structure view of Dependinator: thin hosts (Web, Wasm, Lsp, Api, and the TypeScript extension) on top of Dependinator.UI, which holds the App, Diagrams, Modeling and Shared areas; the Roslyn, Bicep, TypeScript, Claude and Mcp libraries plug into Dependinator.Core, which holds parsing contracts, RPC, cloud sync client, the AI and MCP contracts, shared services and utilities; Shared holds the DTOs the API also uses. Architecture tests enforce that references only point down.
